$Comment: MeleeHit punches (and their CAE overrides, which take this file as Parent). 2026-10-21 (playtest: every hit of the king applies frost): half a frost stack through AT_Ice_King_Frost_Half_Hit (every second such hit adds one stack), since this hit is quick and frequent. Next is inherited by the Parent overrides. 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): Punch_Hit when a punch lands (this hit is MeleeHit's, used by the punches and their CAE overrides). 2026-10-22 block stamina (playtest: blocking the king with a plain sword barely cost stamina, 50 hits in a row): a blocked hit costs InitialAmount / StaminaCost.Value stamina (DamageSystems.DamageStamina; vanilla sword and shield Value 10 = 1 stamina per 10 damage, player stamina max 10, no regen while guarding, below 0 the guard breaks), times DamageEffects.StaminaDrainMultiplier (official field, inherited by Parent overrides; vanilla Gobliterator uppercut 10). StaminaDrainMultiplier 2: a blocked hit costs 2 x its damage / 10 (about 4 stamina for 20 damage; the CAE's 22-damage override about 4.4).
